heading: Goods movement services
bodyCopy: The Common Transit Convention (CTC) is a customs procedure that allows you to quickly move goods between countries in:
It can help reduce the number of customs declarations you'll need to complete and you won't have to pay charges until you end the movement.
To move your goods using the CTC, you need to:
check if you can use it
find out how to use it to move goods
plan your route before you use it
Find out more about using transit to move goods (opens in new tab)
GVMS helps to speed up customs clearance at some UK ports.
To move your goods, you need to:
Find out which ports use the GVMS (opens in new tab)
Register for the GVMS (opens in new tab)
Get a goods movement reference (GMR) (opens in new tab)
The GMR is a single reference that brings together multiple declarations. Without it, you cannot move your goods through UK ports which use the GVMS and you may face delays.
The driver must check the GVMS to find out if an inspection is required before they disembark.

fields.name: ctc-question
fields.label: Are you using the Common Transit Convention (CTC) to move goods between countries?
fields.hint: If yes, you must provide the Movement Reference Number (MRN) that will have been generated by NCTS.
fields.requiredEvidence: Required for completed CHED-P notifications in the authorised legacy model: PartOne.provideCtcMrn is @NotNull for ProvideCtcMrnValidation (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/PartOne.java:661-668), and that group is always included for CVEDP (ipaffs-notification-microservice/service/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notification/validators/field/PartOneFieldValidator.java:176-180). The page-level Joi rule remains optional (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/goods_movement_services_validation.js:32-34), so this is legacy completion mandatoriness rather than an HTML required attribute.
fields.conditionalOn: The question is not shown for every port/transport combination. Where shown, the rendered non-transit variant has three options (add MRN now / later / No); another CHED-P workflow uses a binary Yes / No variant.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 110 (radio ids ctc-question-yes / ctc-question-yes-add-later / ctc-question-no; 'No' checked). QA page object exposes both binary Yes/No and three-way add-now/add-later/No locators: page-objects/notification/GoodsMovementServicesPage.ts:6-19. The general CHED-P workflow drives binary Yes/No at workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:486-492; the non-transit workflow drives all three choices and tolerates the question being absent at workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:578-600,603-625. All three non-transit selections are exercised in risk-outcome scenarios at tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-inspection-non-transit.spec.ts:19-75,81-102.

fields.name: ncts-mrn
fields.label: Movement Reference Number (MRN)
fields.hint: It is 18 characters, starting with 2 numbers, a 2-letter country code then 14 letters and numbers. For example, 24GB123456789AB012.
fields.requiredEvidence: Conditionally required when ctc-question is YES: the legacy page validator switches ncts-mrn to Joi.string().required().length(18).regex(NCTS_MRN_REGEX) only for that branch (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/goods_movement_services_validation.js:11-25). It is optional for the other CTC answers (same file:26-29).
fields.conditionalOn: ctc-question = 'Yes – add MRN now' (govuk-radios__conditional reveal; hidden in the observed 'No' state)
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 110 (input#ncts-mrn present in DOM inside conditional reveal; not exercised in this trace). QA locator: page-objects/notification/GoodsMovementServicesPage.ts:21-23. The CTC='yes' workflow selects 'Yes – add MRN now' and fills a generated MRN: workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:615-617. The generator supplies YY + GB + 9 random digits + AB012, exactly 18 characters: utils/reference-utils.ts:1-8.

fields.name: gvms-question
fields.label: Will the transport use the Goods Vehicle Movement Service (GVMS)?
fields.requiredEvidence: Required for completed CHED-P notifications when this question applies: PartOne.isGVMSRoute is @NotNull for NotificationGvmsRouteValidation (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/PartOne.java:649-657), and that group is always included for CVEDP (ipaffs-notification-microservice/service/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notification/validators/field/PartOneFieldValidator.java:176-180). The legacy handler defaults an unset CVEDP value to No (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/goods_movement_services.js:91-97), while the page-level Joi field is optional (service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/goods_movement_services_validation.js:32-34).
fields.conditionalOn: The question is only shown for applicable port/transport combinations and the entire Goods movement services page may be skipped when neither CTC nor GVMS applies.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 110 (radio ids gvms-question / gvms-question-2; 'No' checked — this is the mined action). QA locators: page-objects/notification/GoodsMovementServicesPage.ts:32-42. The workflow explicitly handles both values and tolerates the question being absent: workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:627-642. Both Yes and No are exercised in downstream risk-outcome scenarios, including GVMS Yes + CTC No yielding 'Check GVMS': tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-inspection-non-transit.spec.ts:19-75,81-102.

validationMessages.trigger: Submitting while the CTC question is visible but no option is selected
validationMessages.evidence: No trace or CHED-P QA assertion captures this state. Every applicable workflow selects a CTC value before continuing (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:486-501,611-642).

validationMessages.trigger: Selecting 'Yes – add MRN now' and submitting an empty or malformed MRN
validationMessages.evidence: No trace or CHED-P QA assertion captures empty/invalid MRN handling. The only QA branch that selects add-now immediately fills a generated valid 18-character MRN (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:615-617; utils/reference-utils.ts:1-8).

validationMessages.trigger: Submitting while the GVMS question is visible but no option is selected
validationMessages.evidence: No trace or CHED-P QA assertion captures this state. Every applicable workflow selects Yes or No before continuing (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:627-642).

openQuestions: Legacy completion validation requires provideCtcMrn and isGVMSRoute for CVEDP (PartOne.java:649-668; PartOneFieldValidator.java:176-180), but the legacy page-level Joi schema marks both radio payloads optional and rendered inputs have no HTML required attribute (goods_movement_services_validation.js:32-34; confirmed trace action 110). The rebuild should decide whether to enforce selection immediately on this conditional page or only before submission; this legacy policy may be revisited.

QA exercises 'Yes – add MRN now' with a generated valid 18-character MRN (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:615-617; utils/reference-utils.ts:1-8), but neither admissible source submits an empty or malformed MRN. Conditional required-ness and exact MRN format-validation copy remain gaps.

QA exercises GVMS Yes and No across multiple downstream risk-assessment scenarios (tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-inspection-non-transit.spec.ts:19-75,81-102), but exposes no follow-up field after Yes. Confirm whether GVMS Yes only changes downstream assessment or can lead to another input/page in an untested combination.

The page/questions are genuinely conditional: the workflow defensively catches absence of either question and only clicks Save and continue when at least one is present (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:603-642). Confirm the exact eligibility matrix by BCP/port, incoming transport mode and journey type; QA comments describe the dependency but do not enumerate it.

The page object and workflows indicate two CTC variants: binary Yes/No (page-objects/notification/GoodsMovementServicesPage.ts:6-11; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:486-492) and three-way Yes-add-now / Yes-add-later / No (page-objects/notification/GoodsMovementServicesPage.ts:13-19; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:615-622). Confirm which journey conditions select each variant and whether binary Yes leads to MRN capture elsewhere.
No validation/error messages were captured in traces or asserted by scoped QA tests. Required-selection and MRN error copy are represented as explicit gaps.

The CTC and GVMS 'Details' explainers contain body copy with embedded links to external guidance (e.g. 'Find out more about using transit to move goods (opens in new tab)', GVMS port/registration links). Link hrefs were not extracted; the visible link text was captured in bodyCopy of the Details components.
